headline: A massive gain for the Chiefs
what_happened: P.Mahomes completed a long pass to T.Thornton for 30 yards to move the offense down the field.
who: P.Mahomes threw the ball to T.Thornton.
why_it_matters: This was a huge play because it kept the drive alive and boosted the Chiefs' chances of winning by 24 percent. It is great news for Kansas City as they push for a score in overtime.
